what: Captions in one of three styles (sentence, word highlight, punchy chunks) on a solid plate, at 60 to 66 px, two lines at most, clear of the player. Set words to a word-timed transcript (a file, or a list of { w, start, end }) to sync them to the voice; with none, the text is spaced evenly over the duration so you can judge the look. Add your voice as an audio entry. Transparent, for over footage.

props.text: A five pound latte is not five pounds of coffee. The beans cost about forty pence. The rest is rent, milk, wages, and the cup in your hand.
